topic: TikTok skit — friend overpaid, you didn't (EN)

lines.text: POV: your friend just booked a flight for two hundred eighty euros.
lines.visualPrompt: person proudly showing phone to friend, living room, casual

lines.text: Without checking anything. Just booked it. Confident.
lines.visualPrompt: person tapping phone confidently, careless booking

lines.text: So you open Flight Price Watch. Same flight. Same dates.
lines.visualPrompt: hand opening travel app on phone, calm and focused

lines.text: And the app shows the price the app has been tracking all week.
lines.visualPrompt: real Flight Price Watch tracker page screen recording

lines.text: One hundred forty euros. For the exact same seat.
lines.visualPrompt: surprised happy face looking at cheaper price on phone

lines.text: You didn't get lucky. You just watched the price instead of guessing.
lines.visualPrompt: two friends, one shocked one smug, funny contrast

lines.text: Your friend is still recovering. You're already packing.
lines.visualPrompt: happy person packing a suitcase, excited for trip

lines.text: Don't guess the price. Track it. Link in bio.
lines.visualPrompt: traveler walking through airport confidently, golden hour
